title: Declarative Metaclass Field Descriptors & Deferred QuerySet Compilation

claims.assertion: Domain models should bind fields via metaclass descriptor synthesis to defer SQL AST generation until terminal execution methods (iteration, slicing, aggregation) are explicitly invoked

context: Eager database evaluation couples business logic tightly to physical I/O boundaries and prevents query optimizations like filter chaining, predicate pushdowns, and deferred column loading.
distilled_learning: Model classes use `ModelBase` metaclass to inspect class attributes, contribute fields into an internal `_meta` options registry (`Options`), and replace raw values with descriptor getters/setters. QuerySet instances represent pure immutable ASTs that clone on every chaining method (`.filter()`, `.exclude()`, `.select_related()`). Physical database queries only execute when the QuerySet is evaluated (`__iter__`, `__len__`, `__getitem__`, `count()`, `exists()`), allowing seamless composition across layers.
